title: Online shopping & delivery app (storefront, orders, delivery tracking)

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and a basic authenticated user session so each order is associated with a specific user principal.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: A user can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity.
The UI clearly shows whether the user is signed in (e.g., header state).
All order-creation actions require the user to be signed in (with a clear prompt if not).

requirements.text: Create backend product catalog support with a small default set of products, including: id, name, description, price, category, image URL (optional), and availability (in stock/out of stock).

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method to list all products.
Backend exposes a query method to fetch a product by id.
At least 8 sample products are available by default after deployment.
Products include price and availability fields that the frontend can display.

requirements.text: Create a storefront UI where users can browse products, search by name, filter by category, and view a product detail page.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Storefront lists products with name, price, and availability.
Search filters products by name (case-insensitive).
Category filter narrows visible products.
Clicking a product opens a detail view with description and price.

requirements.text: Implement a client-side cart with add/remove/update quantity, cart persistence for the current session, and an order summary (subtotal and item count).

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: User can add items to cart from product list or product detail.
User can change quantities and remove items from cart.
Cart shows subtotal and total item count.
Cart state persists across page navigation within the app session.

requirements.text: Implement backend order creation and storage. An order must include: orderId, user principal, line items (productId, name snapshot, unit price snapshot, quantity), delivery address, contact phone, createdAt timestamp, and status.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an update method to create an order for the authenticated caller.
Order stores snapshots of product name and price at time of purchase.
Backend exposes a query method to list orders for the authenticated caller.
Orders persist across canister upgrades within the same deployment (stable storage).

requirements.text: Create a checkout UI that collects delivery address and contact phone, shows the order summary, and places an order through the backend.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Checkout requires non-empty delivery address and contact phone validation with inline error messages.
Submitting checkout creates an order and shows a confirmation screen with the orderId.
After successful order placement, the cart is cleared.
If the backend returns an error, the UI displays an English error message and keeps the cart intact.

requirements.text: Implement delivery tracking statuses and an order tracking UI. Statuses must include at minimum: Placed, Preparing, Out for delivery, Delivered, Cancelled. Include a simple status timeline on the order detail view.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Each order has one of the defined statuses stored on the backend.
Frontend shows a list of the user’s orders with current status and created date/time.
Order detail view shows a timeline/stepper highlighting the current status.
At least one backend method exists to retrieve a single order by id for the authenticated caller.

requirements.text: Add a minimal admin-only capability (restricted to a configured list of principals in code) to update an order’s status to support simulated delivery progress.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Only configured admin principals can update order status; non-admin calls are rejected.
Admin can set order status to any of the supported statuses.
Status updates are reflected when the user reloads their order detail view.

requirements.text: Add core navigation and pages: Storefront, Cart, Checkout, My Orders, Order Detail. Ensure routing and empty states are user-friendly and in English.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: All pages are reachable from a consistent header/navigation.
Cart empty state has a clear call to action to return to the storefront.
My Orders empty state explains that no orders exist yet.
Order not found and unauthorized states are handled gracefully.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, component styles) suitable for a modern grocery/retail delivery experience, and keep it consistent across all pages.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: The app uses a consistent theme across header, buttons, cards, and forms.
Pages share consistent layout structure and spacing rules.
User-facing text is in English and consistent in tone and terminology.

requirements.text: Render the generated images (logo and hero illustration) as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the UI.

quotes:
Create a online shoping
 delivery app

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the frontend via static paths.
The logo is displayed in the app header.
A hero illustration is displayed on the storefront/home section without requiring any backend calls.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo; create backend/migration.mo only if upgrading existing state requires it).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths designated immutable by the template (compose them instead).
Use English for all user-facing UI text.
nonGoals: Integrating real payment providers (Stripe/PayPal) or storing credit card data.
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
External databases or external hosting providers.

required: Minimal modern delivery app logo, flat vector style, warm palette (shop-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Storefront hero illustration showing shopping bag and delivery scooter, clean flat illustration, warm palette (store-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
